thread:
nina (AE): Aurora Bank ready for a gated 2-week POC. They returned our enterprise auth checklist and added asks: SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning, RBAC/group mappings, domain allowlist, audit log retention, POC price, and procurement contact. Need a short unblock list by EOD.
leo (SE): I'll draft the checklist. Please send IdP metadata (XML or Okta/Azure link), ACS URL/EntityID we should use, NameID preference (email vs persistent), desired SAML attributes (email, displayName, groups), SCIM base URL and bearer token, expected provisioning cadence and user volume, canonical group names for mapping.
ara (Security): Add: completed security questionnaire (they sent a 26-page PDF), SOC2 evidence under NDA, encryption at rest details, KMS/customer key options, IP allowlist ranges, audit log retention period (we can offer 90/180/365 days), and subprocessor list.
rachel (Legal): For procurement I need contact name + email, PO requirements, and whether they need an NDA before SOC2. We'll prepare a short SOW for a 2-week POC and a DPA addendum. Recommend offering a POC credit applied to first invoice unless they insist on a fixed fee.
nina (AE): Timing: start next Monday, 2 weeks. They also asked for an estimate for Dedicated at ~150k tok/day. Quick numbers?
leo (SE): For a small hosted POC (dev seats, <10k tok/day) recommend reserving a dev pool at $900/week to guarantee latency. Dedicated ~150k tok/day is roughly $9k-$11k/mo depending on model and quantization; call out model choice caveat.
leo (SE): SCIM example to share (compact): POST /scim/v2/Users Authorization: Bearer <token> Content-Type: application/json {"userName":"a.kim@aurora.com","name":{"givenName":"Ari","familyName":"Kim"},"emails":[{"value":"a.kim@aurora.com","primary":true}],"externalId":"aurora-77","groups":[{"display":"eng"}]}
ara (Security): Note RBAC: request canonical group->role mapping. We support both SAML group assertions and SCIM group sync. Default SCIM rate limit 100 req/min; Dedicated can increase. For bulk imports (>10k users) prefer CSV bulk job. We provide time-limited emergency admin tokens and audit of admin actions for rollback.
ops-bot: Created channel #sales-aurora-poc (workspace id: w-7721) and invited SE/security/legal.
nina (AE): Actions: leo send checklist + examples to customer today; ara draft security answers for the PDF; rachel draft SOW + DPA for review. I'll collect procurement contact and confirm POC pricing path. Target: checklist out today, SOW by tomorrow.
